result.instructions: Tools for Quipu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices are unpaid or overdue, and how much do I owe in total?"; "How much did I invoice in the second quarter of 2026, with VAT and IRPF retention?"; "Create a client contact for Acme S.L. with its NIF and email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quipu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quipu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quipu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quipu_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. quipu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quipu_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (clients and suppliers) of the Quipu account. Filter by kind, tax id, country, email or free text.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example ES.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending.

tools.name: quipu_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with its totals of paid and unpaid incomes and expenses.

tools.name: quipu_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (issued and received). Filter by kind, period, operation date, payment status or contact. Totals and PDF links are in the attributes.

kind.description: income = issued invoices, expenses = received invoices.

operation_date.description: Year (2024), quarter (2024-Q1), month (2024-3) or all. Works with kind=income.

operation_date_from.description: Start of an explicit range; send with operation_date_to. Works with kind=income.

operation_date_to.description: End of an explicit range; send with operation_date_from.

payment_status.description: Payment status. unpaid includes pending and overdue.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include (for example contact,items).

tools.name: quipu_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. Income invoices include download_pdf_url and ephemeral_open_download_pdf_url (a temporary PDF link).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include (for example contact,items).

tools.name: quipu_list_book_entries
tools.description: List all book entries (invoices, tickets and other accounting entries) in one list. Filter by type, kind, period, dates, payment status or contact.

kind.description: income = issued invoices, expenses = received invoices.

operation_date.description: Year, quarter, month or all. Works with kind=income.

payment_status.description: Payment status. unpaid includes pending and overdue.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to include (for example contact,items).

with_detailed_amounts.description: Add detailed amounts to each entry.

tools.name: quipu_list_numbering_series
tools.description: List invoice numbering series (prefixes). Use a series id when you create a draft invoice.

tools.name: quipu_list_accounting_categories
tools.description: List accounting categories (chart of accounts groups). Filter by kind, prefix or active state.

tools.name: quipu_list_accounting_subcategories
tools.description: List accounting subcategories, optionally for one accounting category.

tools.name: quipu_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact (client or supplier). WRITE: it adds a record to the Quipu account. A tax id is needed before you invoice the contact.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code, for example ES.

tools.name: quipu_update_contact
tools.description: Update fields of one contact. WRITE: it changes the record; only the fields you send change.

tools.name: quipu_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT income invoice for a contact. WRITE: it adds a draft to Quipu. It sends no issue date or number, so Quipu does not issue or register the invoice; finalize it in the Quipu app.

operation_date.description: Date of the delivery or service.

unitary_amount.description: Unit price before tax, as a decimal string.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Quipu
prompts.description: What you can do with Quipu here, with example requests to try.
